title: Sound system equipment — Part 3: Amplifiers
abstract: Defines specifications, characteristics, and measurement methods for sound system amplifiers, including balance factor and Common-Mode Rejection Ratio (CMRR).

key_clauses.balance_definition: A circuit is balanced if the voltages between each conductor and a reference point (ground) are equal in magnitude and 180° out of phase, and the impedances between each conductor and reference point are equal.
key_clauses.cmrr_measurement_method: Common-mode generator V_cm is connected to Pin 2 and Pin 3 simultaneously relative to Pin 1. Differential audio output V_dm_out is measured.
key_clauses.source_impedance_imbalance_test: Tested with matched source (0 Ω imbalance) and with standardized 10 Ω (modern) or 600 Ω (legacy) series resistor inserted in one leg to simulate real-world driver/cable imbalance.

relevance_to_balanced_audio: The normative test procedure cited in AES-X152 Part 4 for verifying real-world CMRR under realistic source impedance imbalances.
